title: DataPraxis：通过验证式工作区演化扩展分析任务
summary: 提出DataPraxis分析任务合成框架，通过逐步丰富并继承验证过的工作区来生成更深层问题，构建了5000条验证轨迹数据集DataPraxis-5K，训练出的DataPraxis-27B在DABStep和JobBench上匹配或超越前沿模型。
summary_en: Introduces DataPraxis, an analytics task synthesis framework based on verified workspace evolution that progressively enriches and inherits validated workspaces to uncover deeper questions. It builds DataPraxis-5K, a 5,000-trajectory verified dataset, and trains DataPraxis-27B and DataPraxis-35B-A3B, with DataPraxis-27B scoring 55.11 on DABStep and 51.9 on JobBench, matching or surpassing frontier models like GLM-5.2.
